data: What is the approximate value of the relative improvement of the blue line  for sentences between 11 and 15 words?

The blue line represents the relative improvement of the best NMT versus the best PBMT submission on chrF1. The x-axis shows the sentence length in ranges, and the y-axis shows the relative improvement. For sentences between 11 and 15 words, the blue line appears to be around 0.015. Therefore, the approximate value of the relative improvement for this range is 0.015.
